title: Ethical Challenges and Evolving Strategies in the Integration of Artificial Intelligence into Clinical Practice
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any benchmarks related to faith or religion. It is a review of ethical challenges and strategies for AI in clinical practice.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a topic of analysis.
